method: Evaluated Blender detailed vertices and BVH triangles, plus three-skew-ray containment witnesses after broad phase. Axes measured from actual front-glass object transforms. Nominal safe configurations evaluated separately from unsafe commanded collisions.
limitations: Photographic estimates, not metrology or an optical prescription.
Finite configuration samples, not a continuous collision proof.
Rays through the external illumination gap exclude the designated condenser optical housing; internal optical prescriptions/light transmission are not inferred.
Barrel lettering/coincident trim and inserted spindle/fastener seating are not all-pairs tested.
Unsafe extreme commands are logged; native contact must stop those configurations and is checked separately.
